column1: # Key Locker AES forms.  F3 is a mandatory selector, regular REX fields are

# HRESET has one fixed F3 0F 3A F0 C0 allocation plus an imm8.  F3 is a
# mandatory selector (not an effective REP), REX fields and 66/67 are ignored,
# and its generated CPU matrix starts at Alder Lake rather than Tiger Lake.
# CLDEMOTE owns NP 0F 1C /0 memory only on enumerating CPUs.  Every prefixed,
# /1-/7, register, or non-enumerating-CPU tuple remains the two-operand P6
# multi-byte NOP.  REX2 map 1 additionally requires APX-F; its complete OFF
# rows are unsupported, while truncation and LOCK errors retain precedence.
# CLZERO is AMD's fixed 0F 01 FC allocation in every mode.  Its accumulator
# address input is suppressed, redundant legacy/REX prefixes are ignored, and
# REX2 map 1 additionally requires APX-F.  The adjacent memory /7 row remains
# INVLPG and all complete profile/LOCK failures remain structural with extras
# PCONFIG owns the single NP/OSZ=0 fixed 0F 01 C5 tuple.  Its 16/32-bit
# descriptor is IFORM 2084 and its 64-bit descriptor is IFORM 2085; all four
# accumulator-family operands are suppressed.  Address/segment/REX prefixes
# are ignored, LOCK/F2/F3/66 are illegal, and REX2 map 1 independently needs
# APX-F in addition to the exact PCONFIG selector.
# AMD MONITORX/MWAITX own the NP fixed 0F 01 FA/FB tuples in every mode;
# MCOMMIT owns mandatory-F3 0F 01 FA.  All architectural operands are
# suppressed, no public named profile claims these AMD-only ISA sets, and
# AMD_INVLPGB owns the NP FE/FF fixed tuples: INVLPGB requires EASZ32/64,
# while TLBSYNC is available in every mode/address size.  Mandatory F2/F3
# select the four SNP forms; all are 64-bit-only except PVALIDATE.  Every
# named CPU profile rejects these AMD_FUTURE-only families, and REX2 map 1
# independently requires APX-F in addition to the exact high ISA_SET bit.
# Intel MSRLIST/WRMSRNS fixed C6 and immediate-selector MSR families.
# Intel ISE Programming Reference #319433-060 fixes W=0 on both immediate
# encodings; pinned XED 2026.08 currently over-accepts W=1.
# Intel PBNDKB and ICACHE_PREFETCH.  PREFETCHIT0/1 promote only the 64-bit
# RIP-relative memory /7 and /6 FAT-NOP encodings on enumerating profiles.
# AMD RDPRU is the single CPL3 fixed 0F 01 FD tuple in every architectural
# mode.  All architectural register operands are suppressed.  Redundant
# legacy/REX prefixes are accepted, while REX2 independently requires APX-F.
# Intel MOVRS PREFETCHRST2 and Knights Mill PREFETCHWT1.  Both are
# address-only memory hints with exact extended-ISA bitmap gates.  REX2 adds
# an independent APX-F requirement; non-MOVRS 0F 18 /4 remains a P6 fat NOP.
# Intel PTWRITE owns F3 0F AE /4 in every mode.  GPRy/MEMy is dword unless

# SSE2 MOVNTI owns the NP/OSZ=0 0F C3 memory row.  Its destination is a

# SMAP CLAC/STAC are fixed, zero-operand, CPL0 forms that write AC.  The
